packageRules.description: Test-only infrastructure ships nothing to production, so a bad version can only turn the required 'build' check red, which already blocks the merge. That makes these self-policing, so all update types automerge including majors.

Build-time only: SourceLink and reproducible-build SDKs emit nothing at runtime, so a bad version fails the build rather than reaching production. GitVersion.MsBuild is deliberately excluded because it determines published version numbers.

WireMock.Net is referenced only by the sample app and its tests, never by the shipped Lightr libraries, so a breaking change surfaces as a red 'build' check. Capped at minor/patch because this repo has very little behavioural test coverage, so the gate is closer to a compile check than a behavioural one.
